title: Escalate alerts by deterministic once, repeated, and persistent rules
narrative: Models may propose alert actions, but code-owned rules decide whether a threshold fired and how far to escalate: once/log, repeated/surface, persistent/propose repair. Decision-plane policy already separates model propose from policy decide (`fangore_decision_plane_policy`). Tracks MH-PA-06[^insp-pa-06].
implementation: JudgementPolicy.decide and RulesDecisionBackend provide model-proposes/code-decides. Desired: alert/error escalation catalog with deterministic once/repeated/persistent stages.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-PA-06, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
